narrative.overview:
The app is a tip jar on a counter: small gifts from passersby, dropped in one at a time. The ground is pale jar glass (bg), the shell (top bar, phone nav, theme color, app icon) is a soft dollar green with white type, and inside it a single ask fills the screen as a light green speech bubble, Want Sage for helping and Need Seafoam for asking, with its title set huge in condensed uppercase in dark green ink. You move through people sideways: drag left for the next ask, drag right to go back, and the neighboring ask's field is already waiting underneath, so every move reads as a cut from one field to the next rather than a scroll. Tap the ask, or swipe it up, and its post opens; that is where you chip in (#235). There is no black anywhere: the darkest value is a green-black ink (#16261d).

The world is always light. There is no dark mode, and `prefers-color-scheme` is ignored (`color-scheme: light`). The working pages (Gifts, Leaders, profile, forms, admin, legal) are quiet and dense on the same ground with white panels, the same two typefaces, the same green filled button, and the same shapes. Asking and helping are a conversation (#205): an ask speaks from the right as a big soft bubble with one tight bottom-right corner, a helper's panel answers from the left with its tight corner bottom-left, and every button, tab, badge, and meter is a pill. Lists are hairline rows, progress is a single thin meter, and states are a small shape plus a word. There are no shadows, glass, or glow, and no dark scrim. The only gradients are fades into the field's own color: photos dissolve into the solid field so the words always sit on field.

The system is built for a phone held in one hand. It works at 360px without horizontal scroll and works without JavaScript, because every gesture has a real link behind it. Logged out, the front door (the home page and the How stories) has no bar at all: the way in lives on the page. At 960px and wider, the nav moves up into the bar, and the feed card takes the post page's shape: a wide landscape ask joined to a 400px Chip in panel, with big Back and Next buttons outside it. On a monitor nobody has to drag.
keyCharacteristics: A pale jar-glass ground and a soft dollar-green shell with white type. Always light, no black anywhere.
One light green field per ask (Want Sage or Need Seafoam) with dark green ink and no scrim.
League Gothic uppercase for titles, set huge and tall. Public Sans for everything else.
Two speech bubbles: asks speak from the right (a 6px bottom-right corner), helpers answer from the left (a 6px bottom-left corner), and only the big color fields grow a pointed tail.
A green filled primary, outlined secondary, and tomato only for errors and destructive acts. Every button is a pill.
A thin pill meter, hairline rows, and Lucide 2px line icons.
Sideways gestures with a way back: left = next, right = back, each mirrored by a labeled rail button.

rules.name: The Dark Ink On Field Rule
rules.body: On a Sage or Seafoam field, every word and glyph set on the field itself is green-black ink (on-field, or on-field-muted for secondary lines), never white and never under a scrim. Filled controls on a field are only Dollar Green (the primary, such as the last step's Sign up, white text), Press Green (a lit rail glyph or the current feed tab, white), or a white example panel.

rules.name: The No Black Rule
rules.body: No black and no neutral gray-black anywhere. The darkest color is the green-black ink (#16261d). (The `#000` inside a mask-image gradient is an alpha stop, not a rendered color.)

rules.name: The Always Light Rule
rules.body: There is no dark mode. The root declares `color-scheme: light`, and nothing reads `prefers-color-scheme`.

rules.name: The Tomato Is Trouble Rule
rules.body: The bad family appears only for errors, disputed gifts, and destructive actions. It is never decoration, never a category, and never the Chip in color.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: League Gothic is only for titles and the wordmark, always uppercase. Every sentence, label, number, and control is Public Sans. Don't use a system face for display.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count, rank, and badge number uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Field Fade Only Rule
rules.body: The only gradients are fades into the field's own color. The feed card photo is masked transparent at 4%, solid from 18 to 30%, and transparent by 58%, and a photo card washes the field (85% field to transparent by 22%) behind the tabs. The post-hero photo is masked solid to 30% and transparent by 62%. The door and step mosaics fade to solid field before the words. Never a dark scrim, a fade to another hue, glass, glow, or a box or drop shadow.

rules.name: The Conversation Rule
rules.body: An ask's tight corner is bottom-right and a helper's is bottom-left, always 6px, and a bubble has only one tight corner. If you can't say whether a new container is asking or answering, it's a helper panel.

rules.name: The Tails On Fields Only Rule
rules.body: A pointed tail is a 22 by 14px clip-path triangle in the field's own color, hanging 12px below the tight corner (bottom-left on the help side, bottom-right on the ask side); from 960px it grows to 40 by 26px and hangs 22px below. Only the big color fields carry one: the home doors, the story fields, and the docked strips. Tickets, the post hero, panels, and cards keep just the tight corner.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Whatever you press is a pill: buttons and tabs. Badges and meters are pills too. A gift's state is never a pill (see State Marks).

dos: **Do** keep the top bar and phone nav Dollar Green (#3a7558) with white type, the pages on the jar-glass ground, and the whole app light whatever the system setting.
**Do** give each ask a Sage or Seafoam field with field-ink type and no scrim, and check that any new category color holds dark ink at 4.5:1 or better.
**Do** shape asks as 28px bubbles with the 6px tail corner bottom-right, and helper panels as 22px bubbles with the 6px tail corner bottom-left.
**Do** make every button and tab a pill, and keep inputs, flashes, and notices at 14px.
**Do** fade every photo into the field's own color so the words and tabs sit on solid field.
**Do** set titles in League Gothic uppercase and everything else in Public Sans, with tabular numerals for money and counts.
